request: Implement priorities 1–4: photo-first My, unified feed/search/detail with feed paging, safe batch photo fill, separate shelf name/cover copy and monthly append preview.

changes.result: Owner My uses compact identity, adaptive balance/charge/history summary and two preserved compact album/library shortcuts. Original-ratio public work photos appear within the initial mobile viewport. Public visitor privacy/large identity and header orders/notifications/settings remain protected.

Feed/search/work detail share a 60px local toolbar. Mobile browser feed removes stacked page description/actions. Feed uses lazy snapshot paging, page counter, desktop/keyboard/accessibility controls and preserves page on signed URL renewal and reaction refresh. Tapped page continues in detail. Work title and image remain accessible detail links.

Opt-in ordinary templates can fill only empty photo slots using pending selection order. All image sources are verified before actual page preview; applying is explicit and one undo/redo transaction restores files, queue, selection and document. Existing artwork/crops are preserved. Cancel, unreadable source and stale owner/document/size do not partially apply.

Shelf name and actual cover text are separate. Cover copy editor previews real layers, applies only text changes across size variants and keeps draft/photo session state in sync. Monthly append preview combines saved pages with actual pending pages and uses the same target-canvas builder as the save payload, preserving existing JSON, authorization, idempotency and CAS.

chrome.note: The five native file-source cases are covered by the passing native suite. Browser tests use valid memory image bytes; native captures retain bundled photographs.

screenshots.note: Actual production Flutter widgets with isolated fixture photos and fake account data. Images are examples, not real user account data.

database.verification: Monthly repository tests cover exact canvas-aware append RPC payload and existing authorization/idempotency/CAS behavior.
